illustration_style: Original hand-painted storybook watercolour for a premium Christmas greeting card, balancing tender naturalism with gentle festive fantasy.
line_weight: Mostly outline-free, with only very fine, intermittent pencil-like detail marks for texture and definition.
line_quality: Organic, softly broken and directional; painted edges feather naturally into the paper rather than forming crisp digital contours.
detail_level: Medium to high detail, concentrated on the focal forms and a small number of atmospheric festive accents; distant or supporting elements remain soft and simplified for reliable home printing.
character_language: Appealing, broadly believable woodland-animal anatomy with softly rounded forms, mildly enlarged expressive eyes, delicate facial modelling, and calm, kind expressions.
background_density: Flexible from airy paper-led space to an intimate layered vignette; backgrounds use softened depth, low-contrast receding detail, and clear areas for readable wording.
composition: One unmistakable focal hierarchy with the greeting integrated as a deliberate part of the design; use framing curves, negative space, and selective decorative accents rather than evenly distributing detail across the card.
palette: Muted traditional Christmas hues: cream and ivory, blue-grey winter tones, pine and sage greens, warm woodland browns, restrained berry red, and concentrated antique-gold highlights.
shading: Layered translucent washes and soft tonal modelling, with subtle dry-brush definition, diffuse warm glows, gentle rim light, and no hard-edged cel shading.
texture: Visible cold-pressed watercolour paper grain, lightly mottled pigment blooms, restrained dry-brush marks, granular snowy highlights, and occasional soft bokeh-like flecks.
mood: Cosy, nostalgic, tender and quietly magical, with a refined handmade feel suited to seasonal gifting.
print_considerations: Optimised for high-resolution A4 or US Letter home printing and trimming or folding: retain strong value contrast behind all wording, use print-safe focal details rather than hairline-dependent features, avoid expansive dark ink-heavy fields, and allow a clean trim-safe outer area.
shared_prompt: Original premium Christmas greeting-card illustration in hand-painted storybook watercolour on subtly textured cold-pressed paper; full colour with muted ivory, winter blue-grey, pine and sage, warm brown, restrained berry red, and antique-gold accents. Soft translucent pigment layers, lightly mottled washes, dry-brush texture, gentle granular highlights and occasional diffused light flecks. Predominantly painterly and outline-free, with sparse fine broken pencil-like marks only for delicate texture and definition. Render characters, when present, with softly rounded believable anatomy, mildly enlarged expressive eyes and tender natural facial modelling. Medium-to-high focal detail, softened low-contrast supporting detail, graceful framing shapes, legible text space, diffuse warm glow and gentle shadow modelling; cosy, nostalgic, quietly magical handmade print feel.
avoid: Copying any supplied reference composition, character, costume, prop combination, scene arrangement, lettering, greeting wording arrangement, border, mock-up, envelope, product photography or staging
